capabilities: Convert Markdown notes to WeChat-compatible HTML with inline styles
Create article drafts or submit direct publish jobs through the WeChat API
Export notes as single long-image or multi-page PNG image cards
Preview articles with selectable layout templates, color themes, and mobile/desktop frames
Upload local images and chosen covers to WeChat as permanent media assets
disambiguation: Not a general Markdown converter or exporter; its output targets WeChat Official Accounts styling, drafts, and image cards.
extras: Desktop-only, and AppSecret storage relies on the macOS Keychain, so macOS is effectively required. Installation is manual from GitHub Releases; the listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed configuration docs are in the Chinese section of the README.
intentEvidence: 从 md-to-sm、obsidian-to-sm 或 wechat-article-studio 升级时，首次启用新版会自动迁移账号配置和本地封面
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to format notes for WeChat Official Accounts, upload local images to WeChat, or push drafts through its API.
